scripts.check: npm run validate:contracts && npm run validate:openapi && npm run validate:completion && npm run validate:artifact-package && npm run validate:monitoring && npm run typecheck && npm run check:codegen:typescript && npm test
scripts.check:artifacts: npm run validate:artifact-package && npm run check:codegen:typescript && npm run build:codegen:typescript && npm run test:contracts:python && npm run test:codegen:rust
scripts.test:codegen:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path codegen/rust/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo test --locked --manifest-path codegen/rust/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:contracts:python: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python validation/tests/test_contracts.py; else python3 validation/tests/test_contracts.py; fi
